source: Data Dawgs normalized forecasting and calculator contract, revised 2026-08-08.
note: A contract is not a forecast. It prevents incompatible models and missing values from being silently normalized into false agreement.

data.canonical_game_id: season_week_away_home using canonical current team abbreviations, for example 2026_01_PIT_CLE
data.canonical_schedule: /data/nfl-schedule.json; integrity.snapshot_id is SHA-256 over canonical ordered game rows
data.normalized_receipt_ledger: /data/model-receipts.json; existing rows are append-only and results remain separate
data.model_id_rule: lowercase stable slug; model version changes do not change model_id
data.snapshot_policy: schedule_snapshot_id identifies the canonical game facts; input_snapshot_id separately identifies the model-specific state, methodology and source snapshots. They are not interchangeable.
data.null_policy: Unsupported values are null. A missing model output is never imputed merely to complete a row. Legacy market values without a named book and observation timestamp are not normalized.
data.probability_rule: Every non-null probability is a finite number in [0,1].

receipt_policy.prospective: Append-only after publication. Record the exact input snapshot and contemporaneous market state before kickoff.
receipt_policy.results: Store outcomes separately and join by forecast_id; never mutate the forecast receipt.
receipt_policy.backtests: Always labelled backtest and never mixed silently with prospective leaderboards.

data.comparable_sample_rule: Leaderboard comparisons disclose each sample and prefer identical game sets. No ranking across silently different samples.

belief_summary.note: Equal-weight descriptive statistics only; this is not a validated consensus blend.

model_scoreboard_contract.selection: Prospective receipts only; latest captured_at per game_id and model_id after bounded filters.
model_scoreboard_contract.grading: No outcomes are joined. The tool is ungraded and does not rank models.
model_scoreboard_contract.consensus: Mean, range and standard deviation are descriptive only; no validated consensus, ensemble, confidence score or predictive edge is claimed.
model_scoreboard_contract.persistence: Read-only. Caller filters and results are not stored.

tier_meaning: The DawgHouse (formerly The Pound) — shelved, with the reason attached.
